Title: Scaling up spatial transcriptomics for large-sized tissues: uncovering cellular-level tissue architecture beyond conventional platforms with iSCALE
Summary: Introduces iSCALE, a method that reconstructs large-scale, super-resolution gene expression landscapes and automatically annotates cellular-level tissue architecture in large tissue samples.
Tags: super-resolution, large tissue, spatial reconstruction, automation

Title: Spatial gene expression at single-cell resolution from histology using deep learning with GHIST
Summary: Introduces GHIST, a deep learning framework that predicts spatial gene expression at single-cell resolution by leveraging subcellular spatial transcriptomics and multi-layer biological information.
Tags: single-cell resolution, spatial transcriptomics, deep learning, GHIST

Title: Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology
Summary: Comprehensive benchmarking of 11 prediction methods for histology-to-ST gene inference using multiple datasets. Evaluates accuracy, generalizability, and translational potential.

Title: Automated cell annotation and classification on histopathology for spatial biomarker discovery
Summary: Combines mIF-based ground truth with H&E co-registration to train a deep learning model for automated single-cell annotation. Achieves 86–89% accuracy and reveals spatial immune interactions predictive of patient survival.

Title: AI-driven 3D Spatial Transcriptomics
Summary: Presents VORTEX, an AI framework predicting volumetric 3D spatial transcriptomics from minimal 2D ST data and 3D morphology. Enables high-throughput, cost-effective reconstruction of 3D molecular maps.

Title: Transformer with convolution and graph-node co-embedding: An accurate and interpretable vision backbone for predicting gene expressions from local histopathological image
Summary: Proposed TCGN, integrating convolution, transformer, and GNN for gene-expression prediction. Achieved high accuracy (median r ≈ 0.23) with low memory footprint and interpretability.

Title: Regression-based Deep-Learning predicts molecular biomarkers from pathology slides
Summary: Introduces regression-based deep learning for continuous biomarker prediction across 11k slides and 9 cancer types, improving prognostic value and interpretability.

Title: Inferring super-resolution tissue architecture by integrating spatial transcriptomics with histology (iStar)
Summary: Presented iStar, a hierarchical model integrating ST and histology to achieve near single-cell resolution and predict gene expression in histology-only tissues.

Title: THItoGene: a deep learning method for predicting spatial transcriptomics from histological images
SpatialPlatform: Seq(Visium), human breast and skin datasets
Summary: Introduced THItoGene, combining dynamic convolution and capsule networks to capture fine molecular features. Achieved state-of-the-art performance in spatial gene prediction.

Title: Spatial transcriptomics analysis of gene expression prediction using exemplar guided graph neural network
Summary: Introduced EGGN, combining exemplar-guided graph structure and attention to improve expression prediction from histology. Enhances spatial contextual inference.
Tags: graph neural network, exemplar learning, gene prediction

Title: Systematic inference of super-resolution cell spatial profiles from histology images
Summary: Proposes a hierarchical super-resolution inference model reconstructing subcellular spatial profiles from histology images, bridging image-only data and spatial transcriptomics.

Title: Breast Cancer Histopathology Image Based Gene Expression Prediction Using Spatial Transcriptomics Data And Deep Learning
Summary: Developed BrST-Net, a deep learning framework using multiple architectures (ResNet, Inception, EfficientNet, ViT) for predicting 250 breast-cancer gene expressions from histopathology.
Tags: breast cancer, EfficientNet, ViT, deep learning

Title: Prediction of cancer treatment response from histopathology images through imputed transcriptomics
Summary: Introduced ENLIGHT–DeepPT, combining predicted transcriptomics with treatment-response modeling. Predicts responders across 6 cancer types with 2.44 odds ratio improvement.

Title: Exemplar guided deep neural network for spatial transcriptomics analysis of gene expression prediction
Summary: Proposed EGN, using exemplar learning and Vision Transformer to enhance window-level gene-expression prediction from histology. Outperforms prior ST predictors.

Title: Spatial transcriptomics prediction from histology jointly through transformer and graph neural networks
Summary: Introduced Hist2ST, combining transformer and GNN for histology-to-ST prediction. Utilizes self-distillation and ZINB modeling to retain biological pathways.

Title: Efficient prediction of a spatial transcriptomics profile better characterizes breast cancer tissue sections without costly experimentation
Summary: Proposed DeepSpaCE, a deep learning model predicting spatial gene expression from histology to highlight hidden invasion regions in breast cancer. Semi-supervised version improves accuracy with unlabeled data.
Tags: breast cancer, spatial prediction, semi-supervised learning

Title: Integrating spatial gene expression and breast tumour morphology via deep learning
Summary: Developed a deep learning model to predict local gene expression from H&E-stained histopathology of breast cancer. Identified 100+ genes whose expression correlates with image features, enabling image-based screening for molecular biomarkers.
Tags: histopathology, breast cancer, deep learning, gene prediction
